_comment: burn, the USER's order (MTG_BURN_ORDER): Shard Volley JOINS the burn instead of trailing every cast in
the sacrifice-land pass (docs/design/burn-cast-order-2026-10-15.md). Four Mountains and an Eidolon of the
Great Revel already in play; hand Shard Volley + Skullcrack; opponent at 6 -- both burn spells are the
kill (3 + 3). Each spell we cast with Eidolon out pings us 2; the order casts Skullcrack and Volley in
the burn tier, so we take exactly 4 (the opponent dies on the second). The generic order cast Volley in
the trailing pass after every other cast -- the same 4 here, but the fixture pins that the sequenced
Volley still pays its sacrifice and kills on time.
